newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: TENNIS-RAIN WASHES OUT CZECH OPEN SEMIS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-RAIN WASHES OUT CZECH OPEN SEMIS.

text.p: Heavy rain prevented any play in the semifinals of the Czech Open women's tennis tournament on Saturday.
Organisers said that weather permitting, the matches will be played on Sunday morning with the final in the afternoon.
They added that if the bad weather persisted, the tournament could be completed indoors.
In the semifinals, Marion Maruska of Austria will meet Romania's Catalina Cristea and Joanette Kruger of South Africa will play Veronika Martinek of Germany.
